name: – After § 2 – Am 22/1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text: 2a. Highlights that ongoing barriers and political pressure to expand regulations have constrained the development of the single market, as noted in the Draghi report; calls for a shift towards a regulatory approach that empowers companies to grow, innovate and lead internationally, thereby restoring the single market as a true engine of growth and competitiveness;
